about:
Kalas Manufacturing operates from Lancaster, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1958 as a small hardware store. The company remains a privately held family business led by the Witwer family across more than three generations, and it employs approximately 700 associates at its Pennsylvania facilities.

The company manufactures copper wire and cable through a vertically integrated process that begins with copper rod drawing and continues through extrusion, stranding, and jacketing. Its product lines include flexible cords — Extra Hard Service (600 V), Hard Service (300 V), and SVT/SVTO types — offered in gauges from 18 AWG to 4 AWG with bare or tinned copper conductors and PVC or TPE insulation. Kalas also provides product development and engineering support, including 3D CAD renderings and field collaboration, as well as custom packaging, line sequencing, and a proprietary inventory management system.

Kalas serves manufacturers of appliances, lighting fixtures, vacuum cleaners, and other equipment that require flexible power cords, along with broader industrial and OEM customers needing wire and cable solutions. Its engineering team works with UL and SAE constructions to meet application-specific requirements.

The company states its purpose as "United to Improve the Lives We Touch," grounded in core values of integrity, caring, honesty, respect, giving, and rewarding. Vertical integration is cited as key to quality control and copper cost management, while flexible manufacturing — small variable lots and short lead times — is positioned to adapt to changing customer demands.
